newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Western Atlas unit,Alcorn in oil venture.
newsitem.headline: Western Atlas unit,Alcorn in oil venture.

text.p: Alcorn Petroleum and Minerals Corp said on Monday it and partners in an oil exploration venture in Gabon have concluded a farm-in agreement with a subsidiary of Western Altas International.
Alcorn vice-president Ponciano Mathay said in a disclosure to the Securities and Exchange Commission the agreement was made with Western Atlas Afrique Ltd.

Under the contract, Western will conduct a three-dimensional seismic programme estimated to cost $3.5 million. It will also pay 80 percent of the projected $4.7 million cost of one well to earn a 65 percent stake in the Etame exploration area.
Alcorn said the agreement is subject to the approval of the Gabon Ministry of Mines and Petroleum.
